title: Implant paper rejected by Journal of Scientific Exploration
summary: Steve Coburn tells of Implant paper rejected by Journal of Scientific Exploration, about unspecified at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Yeah, he he and I tried to write a paper and we tried to publish it in the Journal of Scientific Exploration

plain: A scientist named Steve Coburn, who studies objects that people say are alien implants in their bodies, says that he and a colleague, Roger Leer, wrote a paper on their work. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that they tried to publish it in the Journal of Scientific Exploration, a journal for research on unusual topics, and it was rejected. Coburn tells it to show how hard it is to get this research taken seriously.
